title: [finding] the `environments.*` any-CONTAINING family is held by a prose docblock alone — `check:exported-any-returns` asks IS-any, never CONTAINS-any, and the sites carry no annotation for text to see
body:
Path: none | 棘轮:`check:exported-any-returns` | 门禁问的是 IS-any、从不问 CONTAINS-any,而那 14 个站点没有任何注解可供文本检查看见 ⇒ 第 15 个会绿着落地

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01QCdUBjM47SxioST9z5Zwdf`) out of the #11925 premise re-verification, where the delivering dev recorded it and declined to file — correctly, since it fits none of the three filing classes. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only; `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `exported-any-returns IS not CONTAINS` · `environments namespace any-containing` · `15th method lands green` · `prose docblock is the only guard` · `#11927 ratchet scope line`.

## The shape

**14** methods in `ObjectStackClient.environments.*` (and its nested `environments.packages.*`) return types that **contain** `any` and carry **no return annotation**. They are deliberate — #12036, whose reason hardened when ruling B on #16325 moved the cloud contracts out of this repo entirely.

⚠️ The problem is not that they are erased. It is that **nothing mechanical holds the family**:

| would-be guard | why it does not see them |
|---|---|
| `check:exported-any-returns` (the #11927 ratchet) | asks whether a return type **IS** `any`, ⛔ never whether it **CONTAINS** one. Its ledger `$comment` states that scope line and the zero-false-positive reason for it — ⭐ the scope is **deliberate and documented**, not an oversight |
| any text search | the sites carry **no return annotation at all**, so `any` / `Promise` / `unwrapResponse` need never appear on the signature line — this is #11925's own thesis |

⇒ ⭐ **the only thing holding this family is a prose docblock.** A **15th** such method added to `environments.*` would land **silently green**.

## Why this is not a defect in the ratchet

⛔ Do not read this as "`check:exported-any-returns` is wrong". Its IS-any scope is what buys it zero false positives, which is what makes it enforceable at all — and #11927 built it precisely to stop the 52nd IS-`any` site, which it does.

⇒ this card is about a **family the ratchet's documented scope leaves outside it**, ⛔ not about widening the ratchet. Widening IS-any to CONTAINS-any across the package is very likely the wrong fix: caller-shaped `any` (better-auth organization metadata, an opaque OAuth client row) is a class the ledger deliberately protects.

## First act

Decide whether this family wants a guard of its own — for example an allow-list pinned to the **14 known sites**, so that a 15th is a diff someone must justify rather than a silent addition. ⚠️ Measure before designing: the count and the membership must be re-derived with a checker-based census, ⛔ never a text search, for the reason above.

## Related, ⛔ not duplicates

- **#11927** (closed) — built the ratchet this card is about; it stopped the 52nd IS-`any` site. This is its scope boundary, not its failure.
- **#11925** — the card whose re-verification surfaced this; its own work premise is dead and it is closed out.
